No.

http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/index.php?line=rulebook

10. Vampire Sects

A vampire must belong to the appropriate sect to receive a
title.

If he's an Anarch (and therefore Independent), he cannot receive the
title.

Titles going inert applies to vampires who already have a title who
change sect. A vampire of an inappropriate sect cannot receive the
title in the first place.
